title: 19-BCV-007R1 - Lowered workspaces in service garages
code_edition: National Building Code – 2019 Alberta Edition (NBC(AE)); National Fire Code – 2019 Alberta Edition (NFC(AE))

facts.text: The revision concerns lowered workspaces in service garages performing oil-change and/or lubrication work only, with the workspace open to the main floor.
Conditions include employee-only use, noncombustible floor surfaces, Part 6 ventilation, at least 2 m headroom, and controls on exits, appliances, flames/sparks, and extinguishers.
One access ladder may replace one of two exit stairs only if workspace area is no more than 150 m² and travel distance to the nearest exit is no more than 15 m.

limitations: This is a provincewide regulator-issued STANDATA variance, not an individual application, site-specific permit decision, or applicant-provided evidence.
